name: epis-transparente
description: Sistema web de transparencia financiera para la EPIS.

scripts.build: python -m compileall -q backend/app && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: python -m pytest backend/tests && npm run test --workspace=frontend && node --test tests/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: python -m ruff check backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.format: python -m ruff format backend && npm run format --workspace=frontend
scripts.format:check: python -m ruff format --check backend && npm run format:check --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: python -m mypy backend/app && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
